title: Hausdorff Dimension of Growth Rate Level Sets in $θ$-expansions
summary: We investigate the Hausdorff dimension of level sets defined by digit growth rates in $θ$-expansions, a generalization of regular continued fractions. For any $α\geq 0$, we prove that the set \[ E_θ(α) = \left\{ x \in [0, θ] \setminus \mathbb{Q} : \lim_{n \to {+}\infty} \frac{L_{n,θ}(x) \log n \log \log n}{S_{n,θ}(x) - L_{n,θ}(x)} = α\right\} \] has full Hausdorff dimension. This extends previous work of Zhang and {Lü} (2016) on regular continued fractions to the broader framework of $θ$-expansions.
